title: Untidy Avalanche, Skyward Remap
summary: In a remote, untidy mountain cabin, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, ate a melancholy breakfast of cheese with a gecko, fully aware of a risky assignment and potential avalanche. Injured, she jogged through a buckram forest, tracked by an unseen foe, the air thick with oil perfume and a sense of jobbery. Until, facing a mirror, she blinked, gaining critical insight into reported eliminations. Now, in the modern morning, the ugly rubbish of the past gone, a transformed landscape revealed an enriched world. Her unopened lantern cast a soft glow, a lost symbol of the century's change.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
